what: The squad that the climb against the gang clones ranks first, as arguments of scripts/pk-squad.ts
status: winner of the bench climb; not run live
evidence: research/gang-clones.md "The climb": hosted bench runs 44265865486 (seeds 1, 2, 3, every condition) and 44265870254 (seeds 4, 5, 6, the squads of three, four and five in each clone mode). Five of ours kill 90 of 90 gang clones over six seeds and five clone modes with no death of ours.

members.note: Four of ours kill 87 of 90 with no death of ours. Three of ours kill 14 of 18 and one account of ours died: do not send three. No bow on any member of four: 7 of 9 kills at 91 Hitpoints a kill; two members with no bow: 9 of 9 at 35. So three strung bows or more.

options: the default SQUAD_OPTS of scripts/pk-squad.ts: no change of one option beat it beyond the spread of one condition

post.reason: the gang's own single-way post: 7 of 9 kills at 100 Hitpoints a kill, against 9 of 9 at 18 on the multi-way post on the same seeds

cycle.note: the wait for a dead gang account (one sample) bounds the kills of an hour of each squad that kills all three; our bench attacks do about 1.1 times the live damage on the gang

cost.note: the live gang took 1.35 times the Hitpoints from our account that the clones take (range 1.27 to 2.05)

notMeasured: lobsters (the bank trip takes sharks only)
a style rule for each gang account and a kill order (one option set and the lowest health bar in scripts/pk-squad.ts)
arrows and runes a kill (not in the RESULT line)
the repeat cycle of 30 minutes (a dead clone does not come back)
the squad on a live run
provisional: a clone has no wait before an eat, our bench account attacks in the tick of its weapon change, and our bench account logs in first; each would move these numbers
argumentsNote: The bench cases pass no other argument of scripts/pk-squad.ts, so each ran at its default in scripts/pk-squad.ts: MARCH=1, PULL=1, PICKUP=1, RESCUE=1, FOLLOW=0, and TRIPS at its default. TARGETS and POST are the defaults of the script too; a bench case names its clone accounts as the targets.
cloneModes: base: each clone walks out at 33 Hitpoints, Ligma has 17 sharks; retreat: walks out at 40; stand: never walks out; lean: Ligma has 6 sharks; full: Ligma has 28. A squad case gives the three clones one option set.
antipoison: five of ours with a potion on the first two members, on one or on none: 9 of 9 kills and no death in each row (seeds 1, 2, 3), at 16 to 30 Hitpoints a kill
